purpose: Localize actual dyld cache failure after BOOT 49f3b166 reached namespace 6 exit with carrier 0/0
scope: PID1 only, last 12 of 24 bounded records for real open/openat, fcntl and shared-region syscall returns
path_source: namei kernel cn_pnbuf only after original successful copy and length validation; no additional user-pointer copy
limits: A path label is the most recently observed copied namei path for initproc, not a full per-thread causal trace. Intended for CPU0 early dyld startup.
No path note does not prove namei was never entered; compound lookup or failure before a new copied buffer can omit a note.
Does not alter syscall arguments, errors, mapping policy, signatures, dyld or storage.
Only on initproc fatal exit is the ring appended to the existing panic.
reference_method: Compare pinned umi bounded exec/critical-exit tracing: observe kernel-owned state without additional user-memory reads. The board diagnostic uses numeric syscall returns and existing namei buffers instead of umi RAM-console/CRC transport.
